note: Clay County Parks campground on the east shore of Smithville Lake, off Collins Road beside the Camp Branch marina and swim beach: paved loops spread over several peninsulas, some on open lawn running down to the shore, others in the trees. --Claude
summary: County guidelines page (undated): 346 sites (200 electric 50A, 146 unimproved), showers, dump, Apr 1-Oct 1, reservable 6 months to 1 day ahead on WebTrac (Cloudflare-blocked, unread), FCFS for unreserved, 2-night weekend min, 15-night max, $40 electric / $22 unimproved + $2. Pin ~520 m off (at a building by Collins Road). Google 4.5 (139). Lakefront lead on the SW peninsula tip.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (stored lakeview, no per-entry evidence): judged per loop on legible leaf-off imagery. Most loops (the north and central loops) sit 50-100 m+ back from the shore behind a paved perimeter path/road that rings the campground between the loops and the water -> lakeview at most. The west loops sit behind a tree band -> no view there. BUT the SW peninsula tip (Google's 'Camp Branch Campground' point 39.40496,-94.52670): its cul-de-sac's ~8-9 outer pads sit OUTSIDE the perimeter path, on open mown grass ~15-40 m from the riprap shoreline with nothing between (the cul-de-sac road is on the inner side); DEM pads 265-267 m vs normal pool 263.3 m, so a walk-across, not a bluff. That meets the open-apron rule and the distance bound - a lakefront upgrade candidate on imagery (no per-site map read; WebTrac blocked). Otherwise lakeview stands.

PIN: stored 39.4120,-94.5190 is a building beside the entrance road ~520 m NE of the loops. The loops (several peninsulas) centre about 39.4090,-94.5245 (Google's 'Camp Branch Campground KCTA' point 39.40996,-94.52314 is near the entrance booth). Move to 39.4090,-94.5245.
